subject: general
question: 6 men can complete a piece of work in 5 days while 2 women can do it in 15 days. In how many days can 3 women and 3 men complete it?3872
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
**Work Equivalence**: 6 men × 5 days = 2 women × 15 days ⇒ 30 M = 30 W ⇒ 1 M = 1 W.

Total work in terms of men = 6 × 5 = 30 units.

Efficiency of 3 women + 3 men = 3 men + 3 men = 6 men.

Time taken = Total work ÷ Efficiency = 30 ÷ 6 = 5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time for 6 **men** = 5 days

Time for 2 **women** = 15 days

 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency**
 6 Men 5 30 6
 2 Women 15 2
**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of 1 man = 6 ÷ 6 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Efficiency of 1 woman = 2 ÷ 2 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Efficiency of (3 men + 3 women) = (3 × 1) + (3 × 1) = 6 units/day

⇒ Time taken = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 30 ÷ 6 = 5 days

**∴ The correct answer is 5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

M-D-H Formula

Used for work comparison: (M₁×D₁×H₁)/W₁ = (M₂×D₂×H₂)/W₂.

Efficiency and Time

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a work.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of work done or the ratio of efficiencies when time is constant.</p
